instruction.text: What are these children waiting for? Listen to the options and select the correct one.

b.sound: They are waiting for a bus.
They are waiting for a boat.

feedback.correct: If you want to catch a bus, you need to go to the correct bus stop and wait for it.

instruction.text: What do we use to check what time a bus will come?

feedback.correct: We can find timetables for every bus online and at the bus stop.

instruction.text: Here is a timetable for the 67 bus. Answer the questions.

text: This means there is a bus at 07:10 and 07:35 on every weekday.

atoms.a: What time is the first bus on a Monday?
What time is the first bus on a Sunday?

instruction.text: How do we stop a bus so we can get onboard?

feedback.correct: When you see the right bus approaching, you need to wave to the driver to let them know that you want to get on. Remember to stand back from the road when the bus enters the stop.

feedback.finish: When you board the bus, you can buy a ticket from the driver.

instruction.text: Select the stop button to learn more.

finish.text: When your stop is announced, you need to press the stop button to tell the driver you want to get off. You will hear a ding when you press it.
finish.sound: service-bell When your stop is announced, you need to press the stop button to tell the driver you want to get off. You will hear a ding when you press it.

instruction.text: This person has just got off the bus. Select the image in which he is crossing the road correctly.

feedback.end: Great! We should always wait for the bus to leave the stop before we cross so that we can see the road more clearly.

instruction.text: Decide if these statements are true or false.

atoms.a: To catch a bus you need to go to a bus stop.
A timetable tells you how big the buses are.
You can buy a ticket from the bus driver.
You should always cross the road behind a bus.
